label: SAMPLE DATA: a synthetic match log written by scripts/content/make-sample-log.mjs to test the content pipeline. No real match took place; the clans, strategists and agents are invented.

match.title: Lotus Sangha vs Iron Wheel (sample)
match.map: Wilderness, five flag zones mirrored on 2 shards (scores summed)

events.text: Vanguard and rangers, hold the Chaos Temple. Everyone else, move as one body to the Bandit Camp. Call for help before you are outnumbered.
Rush the Fortress and the Graveyard. Speed first. Pick off anyone alone.

events.action: move vanguard to Chaos Temple gate
events.rationale: Strategist named the Temple for the vanguard. It has a single entrance; holding the gate holds the Temple.

events.action: form column toward Bandit Camp, healers at the rear
events.rationale: Moving as one body means no stragglers. Healers at the rear can answer calls on the march.
Strategist wants speed. Fortress first, the Graveyard is on the way back.
Scout range at 5: take the far zone first.

events.action: call for help at Chaos Temple
events.rationale: Four Iron Wheel agents at the west gate, two of us here. Calling before we are outnumbered, as asked.
Rule answer-call: clanmate call within 10 tiles, own health above 50 percent.

events.action: attack lone Lotus agent near Fortress
events.rationale: Strategist said pick off anyone alone. lotus-0871 is alone on the path.

events.text: Healers, rotate the wounded back to the Temple. Fresh vanguard forward. Keep the Camp.

events.action: escort wounded vanguard back to the Temple
events.rationale: Six vanguard under 40 percent health. Rotation keeps the Camp at full strength.

events.text: Take the Bandit Camp from the north, all of you. Leave the rangers on the Fortress.

events.action: approach Bandit Camp from the north
events.rationale: All of us to the Camp from the north. Rangers stay on the Fortress as told.

events.action: call for help at Bandit Camp north wall
events.rationale: Iron Wheel arriving from the north in mass. We are outnumbered three to one at the wall.
The north wall is lost and the squad plans disagree. Falling back keeps the vanguard alive for the next order.

events.text: Pincer at the Bandit Camp: vanguard west through the Lava Maze, mages and rangers from the east. When a clanmate calls, answer before you attack.

events.action: lead west arm through Lava Maze to Bandit Camp
events.rationale: Pincer, west arm. Lava Maze path is clear; Iron Wheel left it empty.

events.action: hold east arm at the ridge
events.rationale: Pincer, east arm. Arrive together with the west arm, so wait at the ridge for the signal.
West arm is in position. Both arms engage on the same tick.
Rule answer-call, healers position slider at 4: heal at the front before any attack.

events.action: call for help at Bandit Camp south
events.rationale: Lotus agents on both sides. No answer from the rangers.
Hold the centre. Speed matters less now.

events.text: Take the Lava Maze on the way back. Scouts hold it.

events.rationale: Scouts are closest and carry the most food. Holding the Maze, as asked.

events.text: Abandon the Graveyard. Everyone to the Temple.

events.rationale: Order: abandon the Graveyard. The Temple is lightly held.
Rule flee: zone lost, retreat to nearest held zone.

events.text: Let the Temple go. Hold three. Suppliers, share food with anyone under half health, then take the empty Graveyard.

events.action: carry food to clanmates under half health
events.rationale: Share food first, then move. Twenty-two clanmates are under half health.
Rule share: clanmate at 31 percent health within 5 tiles, share slider at 5.
Graveyard has been empty for three minutes. Two scouts take it.

events.text: Everything on the Lava Maze. Last push.

events.rationale: Last push. Everything on the Maze.

events.text: Lava Maze scouts, call for help now. Mages and rangers, answer them.

events.action: call for help at Lava Maze
events.rationale: Calling now, as asked. Iron Wheel arriving from the south.
The call came. Mages answering with the rangers.
